statement.text:
Determine the structure of infinite 2-transitive permutation groups (G, Ω) in
which the stabilizer of a point α ∈ Ω has the form Gα = A · Gαβ where Gαβ is the
stabilizer of two points α, β, α ̸= β, such that Gαβ contains an element inverting the
subgroup A. Suppose, in particular, that A \ {1} contains at most two conjugacy
classes of Gα ; does G then possess a normal subgroup isomorphic to P SL2 over a
field?                                                                    A. N. Fomin
